利益相关审查:CDC(YRBS)与 SAMHSA(NSDUH)均为数据生产方兼发布方,其自我披露的方法断点属对己不利的披露,可信度高而非利益驱动。Keyes 等为 NIH 资助学术分析,未见商业利益冲突;Mojtabai 等同。无一来源来自倡导团体或产业方。

corrections: 【裁决 2011 基线】36% 正确,35% 错误。一手:MMWR Surveill Summ 2012;61(SS-4) Table 21「Percentage of high school students who felt sad or hopeless」女生 Total = 35.9%(95% CI 34.1–37.8),男生 21.5%,全体 28.5%。35.9 → 四舍五入 36%。旁证:CDC 2023 新闻稿称 57% 相当于「nearly 60% increase」,57/35.9 = +58.8%(若基线为 35%,则为 +62.9%,应写「over 60%」),与 36% 自洽。建议写法:2011=35.9%(常引作 36%)。

【CDC 2023 引语逐字】修正前「highest level reported IN the past decade」→ 修正后「the highest level reported OVER the past decade」。完整原句(2023-02-13 稿):「According to new CDC data … nearly 3 in 5 (57%) U.S. teen girls felt persistently sad or hopeless in 2021—double that of boys, representing a nearly 60% increase and the highest level reported over the past decade.」介词为 over 非 in。

【最重要:十年首降的归属错误】修正前「2021→2023 为十年首降(CDC 2024-08-06 新闻稿逐字)」→ 修正后:CDC 2024-08-06 新闻稿全文中不存在 first/first time/decade 首降一类措辞,逐字核对失败,属误植引注。该稿的实际措辞只有「improvements」「Key improvements to youth mental health from 2021 to 2023 include: Decreases in the percentage of students overall who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness (from 42% to 40%)」。「十年首降」这一事实本身可成立,但须归因于数据序列而非 CDC 措辞——依据是 CDC《YRBS Data Summary & Trend Report 2013–2023》总体序列 2013/2015/2017/2019/2021/2023 = 30/30/31/37/42/40,窗口内 2021→2023 确为首次下降(2013→2015 为持平非下降)。

【下降的适用范围被放大】修正前「2021→2023 为十年首降」(读作全面反转)→ 修正后:CDC 同一报告明确,长趋势方向仍是上升——「The percentage of female students who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness increased from 2013 to 2023 but decreased from 2021 to 2023」;男生「increased from 2013 to 2023 but did not change from 2021 to 2023」(男生 29%→28% 未达显著);按种族「For most groups … did not change from 2021 to 2023」,仅西班牙裔学生下降。即两年期下降只见于全体、女生、西班牙裔三项。

【2023 数值为 CDC 四舍五入值】修正前 女 53%、全体 40%(当作精确值)→ 修正后:一手精确值为 女生 52.6%、全体 39.7%(MMWR Suppl 2024;73(4) 《Mental Health and Suicide Risk Among High School Students and Protective Factors》);男生 27.7%。53%/40% 是 CDC 新闻稿与 DSTR 图注的取整。2021 对应值:女 57.0%、全体 42.3%。

【SAMHSA 引语非逐字】修正前「estimates from this year should not be compared with previous years」→ 该字符串在所指 PDF 全文(提取后约 106 万字符)中不存在,逐字核对失败。修正后应改用同一 PDF 内的真实原文,任选其一:(1)「Because of changes to data collection procedures and other methodological changes for 2021, estimates between 2021 and prior years should not be compared.」;(2)「methodological investigations led to the conclusion that estimates based on multimode data collection in 2021 are not comparable with estimates from 2020 or prior years. Therefore, national reports and tables for the 2021 NSDUH present estimates from 2021 only.」;(3)「No statistical tests will be performed to compare estimates in 2021 with those in 2019 or prior years because estimates from a multimode year are not comparable with estimates from a single-mode year」。URL 本身有效(HTTP 200,3.78 MB)。

【断点是双重的,不止 2021】修正前 只提 2021 改版断点 → 修正后:官方同时声明 2020 亦不可比——「SAMHSA to conclude that estimates for 2020 (which included multimode data collection) should not be compared with estimates for 2021」,且「no statistical tests will be performed to compare 2020 estimates (based on two quarters of data) with those of any other year, including 2021」。故 2005→2021 连线跨越的是 2020 与 2021 两处官方断点。

【8.7%(2005) 的出处应写明是二手再分析】修正前 隐含为 NSDUH 官方口径 → 修正后:8.7% 来自 Mojtabai, Olfson & Han 2016《National Trends in the Prevalence and Treatment of Depression in Adolescents and Young Adults》(Pediatrics),对 NSDUH 微观数据的再分析,12–17 岁过去 12 个月 MDE,n=172,495。原文:「The 12-month prevalence of MDEs increased from 8.7% in 2005 to 11.3% in 2014 in adolescents」。

【8.7%→20.1% 连线还掩盖了前段平台期】该序列前七年基本持平:2005–2011 = 8.7, 8.0, 8.2, 8.4, 8.0, 8.0, 8.3(Mojtabai 2016 表),原文亦称「the prevalence of 12-month MDE was stable over the 2005 to 2011 period; however, it gradually increased in later years」。故起点取 2005 会把一段平台期计入「涨幅」,直接两点连线在口径上偏松;更稳妥的表述是「2011/2012 年前后起转折」。

【(b) 有更贴题的官方引注可替换】NIMH 在其 major depression 统计页对同一 20.1% 数字自带断点声明,且措辞与论断原意更接近:「2021 NSDUH estimates are not comparable with estimates from prior years given the use of multimode data collection procedures throughout the entire year and the rate of non-response.」建议以此替代被误引的 SAMHSA 句。
evidence_notes: CDC 2023-02-13 新闻稿(Wayback 快照 20230228172651,原 URL https://www.cdc.gov/media/releases/2023/p0213-yrbs.html;cdc.gov 直连对 WebFetch 与 curl 均返回 403,故走存档):日期栏「For Immediate Release: Monday, February 13, 2023」。核心句逐字见 corrections。同稿另称女生「Nearly 1 in 3 (30%) seriously considered attempting suicide—up nearly 60% from a decade ago」。

CDC《YRBS Data Summary & Trend Report 2013–2023》(https://www.cdc.gov/yrbs/dstr/pdf/YRBS-2023-Data-Summary-Trend-Report.pdf,经 Wayback 取得):总体序列表列 2013–2023 = 30/30/31/37/42/40;图注 女生 2013=39%、2021=57%、2023=53%,男生 2013=21%、2021=29%、2023=28%;文字「Two-year changes show a recent decrease in the percentage of high school students who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness from 2021 to 2023. All other experiences and behaviors did not change.」

MMWR Surveillance Summaries 2012;61(No. SS-4)(2011 YRBS)Table 21「Percentage of high school students who felt sad or hopeless, by sex, race/ethnicity, and grade」:Total 女 35.9 (34.1–37.8)、男 21.5 (19.9–23.1)、全体 28.5 (27.2–29.7)。正文:「During the 12 months before the survey, 28.5% of students nationwide had felt so sad or hopeless … higher among female (35.9%) than male (21.5%) students」。构念定义(脚注):「Almost every day for 2 or more weeks in a row so that they stopped doing some usual activities」+「During the 12 months before the survey」——单题、自报、12 个月窗口,非临床诊断。

MMWR Suppl 2024;73(4)《Mental Health and Suicide Risk Among High School Students and Protective Factors — YRBS, United States, 2023》(PMC11559681):「Overall, 39.7% of students experienced persistent feelings of sadness and hopelessness, 28.5% experienced poor mental health, 20.4% seriously considered attempting suicide, and 9.5% had attempted suicide.」「The prevalence among female students was higher than among male students for persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness (52.6% versus 27.7%)」。

SAMHSA《2021 NSDUH Methodological Summary and Definitions》(https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/reports/rpt39442/2021NSDUHMethodSummDefs100422.pdf,直连 HTTP 200 + Wayback 镜像字节数一致 3,783,516,双源确认):全文检索「should not be compared」仅两处、「not comparable」四处,均列于 corrections;检索「from this year」零命中。

NIMH Major Depression 统计页(https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/statistics/major-depression):「An estimated 5.0 million adolescents aged 12 to 17 in the United States had at least one major depressive episode. This number represented 20.1% of the U.S. population aged 12 to 17.」女 29.2%、男 11.5%;「In 2021, an estimated 40.6% of U.S. adolescents with major depressive episode received treatment in the past year.」数据年份为 2021 NSDUH。论断 (c) 四个数字全部逐字对上,无修正。

Keyes CM et al.《Recent increases in depressive symptoms among US adolescents: trends from 1991 to 2018》,Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol. 2019 Mar 30;54(8):987–996;doi:10.1007/s00127-019-01697-8;PMID 30929042 / PMC7015269。摘要逐字:「Data are drawn from 1991 to 2018 Monitoring the Future yearly cross-sectional surveys of 8th, 10th, and 12th grade students (N = 1,260,159). Depressive symptoms measured with four questions that had consistent wording and data collection procedures across all 28 years.」「Among girls, depressive symptoms decreased from 1991 to 2011, then reversed course, peaking in 2018; these increases reflected primarily period effects, which compared to the mean of all periods showed a gradual increase starting in 2012 and peaked in 2018 (estimate = 1.15, p < 0.01). Cohort effects were minimal」。论断 (d) 的 N≈126 万、措辞恒定四题、2012 起反转、2018 峰、period effect 全部成立,无修正。
Keyes 2019 构念边界(供行文用):其结局是 MTF 四题自评「depressive symptoms」量表,非 MDE、非临床诊断;与 (b)(c) 的 NSDUH MDE、(a) 的 YRBS 单题并非同一构念,三者不可互相换算或串成同一条曲线。

利益相关性核查:CDC(YRBS)、SAMHSA/NIMH(NSDUH)为联邦统计机构,发布的是自家调查,存在机构自利于强调议题严重性的一般性倾向,但本组数字均可在其技术报告(MMWR、DSTR、Methodological Summary)中回溯到表格层级,且 SAMHSA 主动公布了不利于连年比较的断点声明;Keyes 2019 为 NIH 资助的独立学术分析,与平台/产业无利益关联。未发现针对上述四项的勘误(erratum)或撤稿。
unresolved: 未从 SAMHSA 一手文件核实:2015 年 NSDUH 问卷改版是否对 12–17 岁 MDE 序列构成第三处官方断点。所查的《2021 NSDUH Methodological Summary and Definitions》未覆盖该问题;SAMHSA 历年报告确曾连续呈现跨 2015 的青少年 MDE 趋势(暗示其认为可比),但本轮未取得明确的官方可比性声明原文。若正文要强调「跨断点」,建议只主张 2020/2021 两处已核实的断点。

YRBS 女生序列 2015/2017/2019 三年的精确小数值未取得。DSTR 2013–2023 的女性趋势为图形,文本仅带 2013=39%、2021=57%、2023=53% 三个取整标签;总体序列(30/30/31/37/42/40)亦为取整值。故「2021→2023 为窗口内首降」对总体已由取整序列 + CDC 文字表述双重支持,对女生则依赖 CDC 文字表述「increased from 2013 to 2023 but decreased from 2021 to 2023」,未能逐年用小数值独立复核。

corrections: (a) 2011 基线裁决 36%，不是 35%。CDC 自己的 YRBS Data Summary & Trends Report 2011–2021 图表标注 female 2011=36%、male 2011=21%，female 2021=57%、male 2021=29%。交叉验证：2023-02-13 新闻稿说 57% 是 'a nearly 60% increase'——57/36=+58%（合 'nearly 60%'），57/35=+63%（会是 'more than 60%'）。故 35% 错误（35% 是 2021 年 Asian 学生与 heterosexual 学生的值，疑为混淆来源）。

(a) 引语逐字有误：修正前『highest level reported IN the past decade』→ 修正后 CDC 原文『the highest level reported OVER the past decade』。完整原句（2023-02-13）：'According to new CDC data released today, nearly 3 in 5 (57%) U.S. teen girls felt persistently sad or hopeless in 2021—double that of boys, representing a nearly 60% increase and the highest level reported over the past decade.'

(a) 出处 URL 有误：修正前 p0213-yrbs-report.html → 修正后 https://www.cdc.gov/media/releases/2023/p0213-yrbs.html（标题 'U.S. Teen Girls Experiencing Increased Sadness and Violence'，For Immediate Release: Monday, February 13, 2023）。同理 2024 年那篇不是 p0806-YRBS-report.html，而是 https://www.cdc.gov/media/releases/2024/p0806-youth-mental-health.html（'CDC Data Show Improvements in Youth Mental Health but Need for Safer and More Supportive Schools'，August 6, 2024）。注：cdc.gov 现对自动抓取一律返回 403，两篇均经 Wayback 存档逐字核对。

(a) 『2021→2023 为十年首降』不是 CDC 新闻稿逐字。数字是逐字的：'Decreases in the percentage of students overall who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness (from 42% to 40%).' 与 'Decreases in the percentage of female students who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness (from 57% to 53%) and who seriously considered attempting suicide (30% to 27%).' 但『十年首降』属推断措辞。CDC 对十年窗口的逐字判词（DSTR 2013–2023）是：'The percentage of female students who experienced persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness increased from 2013 to 2023 but decreased from 2021 to 2023.' 男生则是 'increased from 2013 to 2023 but did not change from 2021 to 2023'（29%→28%）。
(a) 『首降』的事实性成立但需注明是分析者措辞：CDC DSTR 2013–2023 总体逐年表为 30/30/31/37/42/40（2013–2023），期间无更早的下降点，故 2023 确为该序列首次回落；女生序列上溯 2011 亦为单调上升（36%→57%）后首次回落。CDC 本身未认证 'first'。
(a) 漏掉一条 CDC 亲自给出的限定语：'The 2021 data are drawn from a year when schooling was still substantially disrupted due to COVID.'（2024-08-06 稿逐字）。即 57% 峰值是 COVID 扰动年读数，把 57%→53% 讲成趋势拐点时须带此限定。

(b) 所引 SAMHSA 逐字句在该 PDF 中不存在。全文检索 2021NSDUHMethodSummDefs100422.pdf（pdftotext 全文 15,266 行），字符串 'from this year'、'this year' 命中数为 0；'should not be compared' 仅两处。修正前『estimates from this year should not be compared with previous years』→ 修正后该文件实际逐字：'Because of changes to data collection procedures and other methodological changes for 2021, estimates between 2021 and prior years should not be compared. See Chapters 2, 3, and 6 in the 2021 Methodological Summary and Definitions report for additional information on these changes.'（术语表前言）；另 §3.3.3.2（第52页）逐字：'...led the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) to conclude that estimates for 2020 (which included multimode data collection) should not be compared with estimates for 2021.'

(b) 论断实质成立，但 8.7%(2005) 的出处应补明：该数字通行引用源为 Mojtabai R, Olfson M, Han B. 'National Trends in the Prevalence and Treatment of Depression in Adolescents and Young Adults.' Pediatrics 2016 Dec;138(6):e20161878（PMID 27940701），逐字：'The 12-month prevalence of MDEs increased from 8.7% in 2005 to 11.3% in 2014 in adolescents'，样本 172,495 名 12–17 岁，数据源 NSDUH 2005–2014。故 8.7%(2005)→20.1%(2021) 连线确实跨越 SAMHSA 官方断点，方向成立。

(c) 全部数字经核无误，无需修正；仅补强一点：NIMH 页面本身即带断点警示，逐字『2021 NSDUH estimates are not comparable with estimates from prior years given the use of multimode data collection procedures throughout the entire year and the rate of non-response.』——即 (b) 的断点由 NIMH 自己转载，不是外部批评者的说法。

(d) 要点全部成立，补两处口径精确化：N 精确值为 1,260,159（非约数才对得上）；措辞恒定四题的逐字为 'Depressive symptoms measured with four questions that had consistent wording and data collection procedures across all 28 years'。另需补一条论断组省略的前段：女生症状是先『decreased from 1991 to 2011』再反转，period effect 逐字为 'a gradual increase starting in 2012 and peaked in 2018 (estimate = 1.15, p < 0.01)'，且 'Cohort effects were minimal'。

Keyes KM, Gary D, O'Malley PM, Hamilton A, Schulenberg J. Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol. 2019 Aug;54(8):987-996. doi:10.1007/s00127-019-01697-8. PMID 30929042 / PMCID PMC7015269（经 NCBI E-utilities efetch 取官方摘要）。MTF 1991–2018，8/10/12 年级，N=1,260,159；四题措辞与采集程序 28 年一致；女生 1991→2011 下降后反转、2018 达峰，主要为 period effect（2012 起渐增，2018 峰，estimate=1.15, p<0.01），cohort effect 极小。

Mojtabai R, Olfson M, Han B. Pediatrics 2016;138(6):e20161878, PMID 27940701 / PMCID PMC5127071（NCBI efetch 官方摘要）：NSDUH 2005–2014，12–17 岁 n=172,495，青少年 12 个月 MDE 由 8.7%(2005) 升至 11.3%(2014)，P<.001。
